incidents.narrative: Whether NATO-led ISAF peacekeeping made Finland a belligerent in Afghanistan

signals.label: Substantive claim

incidents.tier_reason: Pattern consistent with a coordinated attempt — because: added by 3 different editors, put back 6 times over 21 days, came with changes to the cited sources, removed as inaccurate, part of a back-and-forth over this passage, automated assessment: a factual or narrative claim.

assessment.what_changed_en: Adds the post-2002 War in Afghanistan to the list of wars involving Finland on the basis of Finnish participation in NATO-led ISAF forces, later citing a 1995 Defence Committee opinion.
quotes: Suomi on osallistunut sotatoimiin Naton alaisissa [[ISAF]]-joukoissa Afganistanin sisällissodassa vuodesta 2002.
assessment.uncertainty_note: Public figures in 2009 did debate whether clashes in northern Afghanistan amounted to armed conflict, but editors noted that a 1995 parliamentary report could not verify claims about a 2002 operation.
assessment.historical_note_en: Finland participated in the UN-mandated, NATO-led ISAF crisis-management operation in Afghanistan from 2002 to 2014 under Finland's military crisis-management legislation rather than a state of war.

incidents.confidence_note: Meets Level 3 thresholds on editor count (three distinct editor keys), 22-day persistence span, and disputed source application.
